note: Every citation the habitability panel and its source make, and what has actually been checked about each one. A verified entry carries a DOI whose Crossref metadata was compared against the cited journal, volume, year and first page. An unverified entry says why, which is a weaker claim stated plainly rather than hidden behind a journal name. Re-check the verified set with ./build.sh citations. Gated by website/src/citations.test.ts.
found: One error in the machine-checked set: Juno's field model was cited as Connerney et al. 2018, Nature 356. Volume 356 of Nature is from 1992, so the citation was impossible. The paper is Geophysical Research Letters 45, 2590.
